title: The Fleet Slips Away
substackTitle: Pearl Harbor, Part 1: The Fleet Slips Away
subtitle: 26 to 29 November 1941. Six carriers vanish into the North Pacific while Washington warns of war everywhere but Hawaii, and in Tokyo the last voices for peace are heard and set aside.
coverCredit: Zuikaku at Hitokappu Bay, November 1941, before the sortie. Japanese photo, public domain (Wikimedia Commons).
synopsis: Six carriers vanish into the North Pacific while Washington warns of war everywhere but Hawaii.
